text:
Maria Chen: Quick thread — need a crisp benchmark narrative + two chart variants for next week's launch post and the webinar page. Primary objective: make the latency vs cost tradeoff instantly scannable for both engineers and platform buyers. Also need inbound routing rules for webinar signups vs benchmark report downloads. Who can help with 3 headline hooks, 2 chart sketches, and CTA split recommendations? cc @Alex O'Neill @Samir Patel

Alex O'Neill: I can take the hooks. Suggest a 3-pillar narrative: 1) "Perceived latency" (p95) — what users feel, 2) "Unit economics" ($ per 1M tokens) — direct cost savings, 3) "Predictable degradation" — reliability/fallbacks. Working headline idea: "Keep latency tight. Cut inference cost." Short and punchy.

Samir Patel: Chart thoughts: Option A -> scatter plot: x = p95 latency (ms), y = $/1M tokens; each point = model variant (quantized/float/batched). Annotate "sweet spot" region. Option B -> stacked bars: baseline cost + batching delta + quantization delta for same throughput. Will mock both. Also recommend a small inset showing throughput (req/s) at target latency.

Jessica Wu: Messaging split: Landing copy A (platform leads): "Predictable inference for production — optimize cost without surprises." Landing copy B (engineers): "Ship faster: 3x cost reduction while keeping p95 under 150ms." CTA guidance: primary CTA = "Request demo" (enterprise-focused), secondary CTA = "Download benchmark" (self-serve devs). Keep social hooks to 1-liners.

Gaurav Iyer: Inbound routing rules (high level): use UTM + hidden form fields for "intent" (demo vs benchmark). Routing heuristics: org_size > 50 OR intent=demo -> SDR queue; else -> drip sequence + immediate PDF + webinar invite. Also add lead score bump for attendees of the live webinar. Example UTM handling snippet below.

```python
# pseudo
intent = request.form.get('intent')
utm_source = request.args.get('utm_source')
org_size = request.form.get('company_size', 0)
if intent == 'demo' or int(org_size) > 50:
    route_to = 'sdr_queue'
else:
    route_to = 'growth_drip'
# persist route_to on lead record
```

Maria Chen: Love these. Two extra asks: 1) Two tweet-length social hooks (one technical, one customer outcome). 2) One-paragraph webinar blurb for the registration page. Timeline: final assets needed by Tue EOD so we can prep the launch email.

Alex O'Neill: Will draft 3 headline hooks + 2 social lines by Mon 12:00 UTC. Example social lines: "Cut inference cost without trading latency. See where the sweet spot lives." and "Prod inference that scales: p95 latency you trust, economics you can measure." :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: I'll upload the first figma mock of scatter + stacked bars to the marketing file space by Mon afternoon and attach PNGs here. Plan to show both with and without annotations.

launch-bot: Reminder — Marketing sync scheduled 2024-07-01 14:00 UTC. Calendar invite created and added to channel.

Jessica Wu: Growth ask: can you prewrite two short email sequences? Sequence A (demo CTA) and Sequence B (benchmark download + webinar follow-up). We'll A/B the subject lines. cc @Gaurav Iyer for routing.

Gaurav Iyer: I'll write the routing rule + sample SQL to pull 'intent' leads for SDR queue. Quick SQL example:

```sql
SELECT id, email, company, company_size, utm_campaign, intent
FROM leads
WHERE intent = 'demo' OR company_size::int > 50
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 500;
```

Maria Chen: Decision for launch: go with the scatter as the hero visual (latency vs $/1M tokens) + stacked bars inside the report to show optimization deltas. Two CTAs on the landing page (Request demo / Download benchmark). Enterprise routing -> SDRs; devs -> immediate PDF + webinar invite. I'll collate everything into a playbook doc and assign tasks. Thanks all — big momentum.

Alex O'Neill: 👍 will post draft hooks in this thread when ready.

Samir Patel: Ping me if you want alternative color palettes for the annotations (high contrast vs publication).

Jessica Wu: Noted — Growth will start email drafts once we have final hero copy.

Gaurav Iyer: Routing rules + SQL pushed to the infra repo, will share link shortly.

Maria Chen: Closing note — please attach final PNGs and the one-paragraph webinar blurb to the playbook by Tue 18:00 UTC.
